title: Northgate Tire Center Loyalty Recognition — Membership-Years Allowance on Treadwear Credits
content:
# Membership-years allowance on treadwear credits

**Schedule.** A Northgate Tire Center treadwear credit carries a membership-years allowance read from the count of membership fee charges on the Northgate Memberships ledger of the membership whose card was presented on the tires' purchase:

| Membership fee charges on that membership | Membership-years allowance |
|---|---|
| 15 or more | $12.00 |
| at least 10 and fewer than 15 | $6.00 |
| fewer than 10 | $0 — no allowance |

## Reading the schedule

- **Which membership.** The purchase on which the tires were bought names the membership whose card was presented; only that membership's fee ledger is counted.
- **What is counted.** Each membership fee charge entry on that ledger counts once.
- **How the allowance acts.** The allowance is a dollar amount added to the treadwear credit. It is added to the prorated treadwear amount once that amount has been fully worked out, it is never itself prorated or multiplied, and the sum is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Boundary counts

| Fee charges | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 9 | $0 |
| 10 | $6.00 |
| 14 | $6.00 |
| 15 | $12.00 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A treadwear credit whose prorated treadwear amount is $27.35, on a presented membership with 12 fee charges, comes to $33.35.
